def _real_extract(self, url):
    display_id = self._match_id(url)
    json_url = f'https://backend.sportdeutschland.tv/api/permalinks/{display_id}'
    try:
        data = self._download_json(json_url, display_id, query={'access_token':'true'})
    except ExtractorError as e:
        if isinstance(e.cause, HTTPError) and e.cause.code == 404:
            # fallback
            slug = display_id.split('/')[-1]
            data = self._download_json(
                 f'https://backend.sportdeutschland.tv/api/permalinks/{slug}',
                 slug, query={'access_token':'true'})
        else:
            raise
